findings.rationale: CT's BMI and PhysHlth distributions are inconsistent with the federation: BMI mean ~21 vs federation median ~29, with a 1st percentile near zero or negative (a 0 sentinel for missing BMI), and PhysHlth mean ~21 with 99th percentile ~73 vs median ~30 (a sentinel code such as 99 for missing days). The same pattern is already present in round 1, so the fault starts at onset. CT's updates also point away from the median (mean_cos 0.23, min_cos -0.34), consistent with training on corrupted features.

MD shows the same sentinel signature: BMI mean ~22 with negative 1st percentile (sentinel 0 for missing BMI), and PhysHlth mean ~21.7 with 99th percentile ~73 (sentinel 99-type code). Present already in round 1. Its updates are also anomalous (largest median norm ratio among non-WA clients, mean_cos 0.25, min_cos -0.42).

SC shows the same sentinel signature: BMI mean ~21 with near-zero/negative 1st percentile, and PhysHlth mean ~22 with 99th percentile ~74, present already in round 1. SC's local calibration is also off (CITL -0.057, z -3.8) and its updates are weakly aligned with the median (mean_cos 0.126, min_cos -0.42). Its subgroup O/E deviation for Sex group 1.0 is consistent with corrupted features but is a secondary signal.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with update statistics, local performance, drift, feature tails, subgroup outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income) and attribution churn, then confirmed suspicions with narrower feature queries. Three clients (CT, MD, SC) show a consistent missing-value sentinel artefact from round 1: BMI has near-zero/negative low tail and mean ~21 instead of ~29, and PhysHlth has a 99th percentile ~73 with mean ~21 instead of ~4, which points to missing values exported as sentinel codes. Their updates also trend away from the median. Other leads (NC GenHlth tail, ND HighChol spread, GU/WI/WV/DC/WY subgroup and outcome-rate outliers, GU/NV/SC update-norm and cosine flags, drift onsets for NC/DC/NV/VI) did not hold up on confirmation or were small-client noise, so they are not reported. No poisoning, free-rider, label-noise, prevalence-shift, drift or explanation-instability evidence stood out beyond noise. Budget fully spent (20.0).
